author: Huawei
description:
From healthcare and education to mining, oil and gas, transportation, and hospitality, AI is embedded into everyday operations.

At #MWC26 in Barcelona, #Huawei introduced a series of AI‑powered innovations that position artificial intelligence as the foundation for next‑generation solutions. By guiding decisions and streamlining workflows, AI helps professionals tackle complex challenges with greater speed and efficiency.

See how AI is shaping smarter operations and delivering measurable outcomes across industries. #AdvancingIndustrialAllIntelligence
title: AI is the Foundation for Transforming Industries

author: Huawei
description:
In healthcare, speed and accuracy are critical, especially when it comes to diagnosis.

At #MWC26, #Huawei showcases how intelligent computing is transforming ultrasound scans. With AI‑powered analysis, doctors can complete a detection scan and receive diagnostic support in just 30 milliseconds. By removing time‑consuming image searching and manual comparison, clinicians can focus on what matters most: patient care.

30‑millisecond health check? Done. #AdvancingIndustrialAllIntelligence
title: 30‑Millisecond Scans? Huawei's AI‑Powered Ultrasound Delivers

author: Huawei

title: Driving AI Data Center Innovation for the Intelligent Future
